definitions.explanation: The title or heading of a written work, document, email, or similar item. A formal word for 'title' often used in written and official contexts.

examples.japanese: {表題|ひょうだい}のとおりです。
examples.english: It is as stated in the subject line.

examples.japanese: {表題|ひょうだい}の{件|けん}について{回答|かいとう}いたします。
examples.english: I will respond regarding the matter stated in the subject.

examples.japanese: {論文|ろんぶん}の{表題|ひょうだい}は{内容|ないよう}を{的確|てきかく}に{表|あらわ}すものでなければならない。
examples.english: The title of a thesis must accurately represent its content.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
{表題|ひょうだい} is a formal word most commonly encountered in business emails and official documents. The phrase {表題|ひょうだい}の{件|けん} (the matter in the subject line) is a standard opening in business correspondence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表題|ひょうだい}の{件|けん} (the matter in the subject)
- {表題|ひょうだい}のとおり (as per the title/subject)
- {表題|ひょうだい}を{付|つ}ける (give a title)
- {表題|ひょうだい}{曲|きょく} (title track — of an album)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- タイトル: title (loanword, more casual and versatile)
- {題名|だいめい}: title of a work (books, films, etc.)
- {標題|ひょうだい}: title, heading (same reading, used interchangeably in some contexts)
- {件名|けんめい}: subject line (specifically for emails)
